reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight is that game script acts as a confounder affecting both offensive and defensive efficiency. By conditioning on pre-game win probability, we isolate the pure skill component of drive-level performance. This requires careful control for omitted variable bias from score differential and ensures that the resulting metrics are comparable across different stages of the game. The empirical implementation involves joining multiple datasets on gameId, posteam, and week, followed by regression adjustment.
